title: The A380 Just Hit MSFS 2024 Marketplace! (iniBuilds A380, Eurofighter & New Add-Ons)
description:
Are you looking to expand your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you trying to decide which new Marketplace add-ons are worth your investment? Today, we are breaking down a massive slate of high-profile releases spanning super-heavy long-haul airliners and Mach 2 tactical fighters to vintage open-cockpit floatplanes and essential livery packs!

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at specs, system depth, aircraft variants, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ COMMERCIAL & HEAVY AIRLINERS
We kick things off with the aircraft everyone has been waiting for: the iniBuilds Airbus A380! We explore both the Rolls-Royce Trent 900 and Engine Alliance GP7200 engine variants, the feature-packed performance EFB, cockpit visuals, and its integration in Free Flight and World Photographer modes. Plus, don't miss the official 9-airline iniBuilds A380 livery mega-pack now available directly in the Marketplace for PC and Xbox pilots for free. We also review Salt Lake Simulations' new A330-300 fleet pack and the 20-livery world pack for the classic Boeing 707.

⚡ FAST MILITARY & TACTICAL FLIGHT
Ready for Mach 2 delta-canard sweeps? We inspect the Bredok3D Eurofighter Typhoon, rebuilt for Flight Simulator 2024. We dive into its Eurojet EJ200 turbofans, PBR cockpit texturing, MFD tactical navigation displays, start-up systems, weapons loadout options, and exterior LOD modeling to see how it performs in the new sim engine.

🌲 VINTAGE TRAINERS, GA & ROTORCRAFT LIVERIES
For scenic low-and-slow cruising, A1R Design Bureau delivers the Ryan STM-2 trainer. We examine its 5 versatile configurations (including floats, long-range tanks, and modernized Garmin G3X glass cockpit options) backed by native CFD propeller physics. Finally, we break down a massive wave of expansion liveries from Jet Studio and partners covering the Curtiss C-46 Commando, DHC-2 Beaver, DA62, Guimbal Cabri G2, H125 rescue fleet, and hot air balloons.

Which of these releases are you taking up first? Setting up a long-haul route in the iniBuilds A380, tearing through the sky at Mach 2 in the Typhoon, or splashing down with the Ryan STM-2? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
